repo.readme:
English  ·  简体中文  ·  Guide  ·  ACP  ·  Extensions  ·  Spec  ·  Website  ·  Discord  ·  QQ


Open source · MIT · runs on your computer, model of your choice

An open-source coding agent for your terminal, desktop, browser and editor.

It reads your project, edits files and runs commands and tests. Have it ask before each step, or work on its own within limits you set. Files its edit tools changed can be rewound. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app.

Maintained by Huahui Yu.

> [!IMPORTANT] > **Community · 加入社区** — bilingual Discord for setup help (`#help` / `#求助`), workflow showcases, and feature ideas. → **** > > QQ group **DeepSeek-Reasonix官方群** (`1093562660`) → **** ([QR code](./docs/assets/qq-group.svg)) > Douyin: **做游戏的小鱼** (Douyin ID `22703872788`) · [QR code](./docs/assets/douyin.png)
## ❤️Sponsor
Thanks to Right Code for sponsoring this project! Right Code reliably provides routing services for models such as Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini, with both pay-as-you-go and monthly subscription billing options available. Invoices are available upon top-up, and enterprise and team users can receive dedicated one-on-one support. Register via this link.
Thanks to PackyCode for sponsoring this project! Access leading AI models through PackyCode with one API endpoint and one API key, with automatic failover and dedicated high-speed routes for Codex and Claude Code. Register via this link.
## What it is Reasonix is an open-source AI coding assistant. The program runs on your computer; the AI model is a service you configure, which receives what it reads. You describe a task in plain language; it reads code, edits files and runs commands and tests inside the project folder you choose, and shows you each step. You pick the model: a DeepSeek preset is built in, any OpenAI-compatible service is one config entry, and you pay the model provider directly. ## What you get - **Read, edit, run.** It reads code, edits files and runs tests and commands, all inside your project folder. - **Permission levels.** Have it ask every time, or let everyday actions run on their own; your forbid rules always hold. To see the approach first, use plan mode: it starts work only once you approve. - **Rewind.** A file is saved before it changes, so you can rewind by conversation turn without touching your git history. Only files its edit tools changed are covered, not what a shell command did. ## 30-second start Download, add a model key, open a project. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app. 1. Download and install the desktop app, Reasonix Studio, from the [releases page](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true). 2. Open it and enter your model provider and key when asked. 3. Open your project folder and write what you want, for example "add retry on failure to the http client". 4. At the level you chose, it stops and asks before anything that needs your say-so. Allow it to continue, or refuse. Prefer a terminal? Download the `reasonix` command-line tool, run `reasonix setup` to pick a model, then run `reasonix`. See [Install](#install) and [Quick start](#quick-start). ## Four ways to use it - **Desktop app (Studio).** A graphical app; the best place to start. - **Terminal.** A full-screen text interface; `reasonix run "task"` also works in scripts. - **Browser.** `reasonix web` opens a web interface on your own machine. - **Editor.** Install the extension in VS Code; other editors that support ACP (Agent Client Protocol, a common way for an editor to connect to an AI assistant) can connect to `reasonix acp`. All four are the same program underneath. What follows is for advanced users and contributors. ## Use it from DeepSeek Harness DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) can hand a task to Reasonix as a subagent over ACP. This repository publishes a plugin index for it: 1. Run `reasonix setup` on the machine that runs `dsh`. In the DSH Web UI turn on Custom plugin markets (Plugins, More) and add this index in the Discover tab: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/studio/integrations/dsh-plugin/market-index.json` 2. Install "Reasonix subagent" from it. 3. Open the plugin's page and turn its switch on. While it is off the model has no `reasonix` tool and may run `reasonix -p` in its own shell, which looks like a delegation and is not one. Setup details, the permission policy and limits are in [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](./docs/DSH.md). ## Versions Reasonix ships on two lines. See the [version roadmap announcement](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/discussions/10748) for the reasoning behind the split. | Line | Branch | Status | Get it | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Reasonix 2.x** | `studio` (this branch) | Active development | [Studio releases](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) | | **Reasonix 1.x** | [`main-v2`](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/tree/main-v2) | Maintenance / stable | `npm i -g reasonix` · [desktop download](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start) | - **Want something stable?** Stay on 1.x. It keeps receiving bug fixes, provider/API compatibility, updater and security fixes; its core architecture is no longer being extended. - **Want the new architecture?** Use 2.x Reasonix Studio. It is still moving quickly; reports are welcome. Valuable fixes, tests and behaviour from 1.x are reviewed one by one and ported or reimplemented on 2.x where they fit the new architecture. - [Moving from 1.x to 2.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md): what the two lines share, and how to run both on one machine without losing sessions. - [2.x roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md): what 2.x still has to deliver, how it ships, and the decisions still open. ## Features Technical highlights for advanced users. - **Config-driven.** Providers, the agent, enabled tools, and plugins are all declared in `reasonix.toml`. No hardcoded models. - **Multi-model & composable.** DeepSeek ships as a preset; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a config entry, not new code. Optionally run two models together (executor + planner) in separate, cache-stable sessions. - **Plugin-driven.** MCP servers contribute tools, prompts, and resources; Extension Protocol v1 sidecars can also intercept runtime events, contribute Providers and structured UI, and ship versioned plugin packages. - **Cache-aware context maintenance.** Startup injects a small stable environment summary, stale tool output is snipped/pruned before summary compaction, and the built-in tool schema contract is documented for regression review. - **Zero-friction distribution.** `CGO_ENABLED=0` single binary; cross-compile to six targets with one command. The result is a fully self-contained static binary — nothing to install on the target machine beyond the binary itself. ## Install This branch is **Reasonix 2.x**. Its desktop app is Reasonix Studio; the CLI, Studio, and editor integrations all run the same local Reasonix engine. ### Reasonix Studio (2.x) Download the package for your platform from the latest [Studio release](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) (tagged `studio-v2.*`; candidates such as `-rc.N` are marked as pre-releases): | Platform | Package | Architecture | | --- | --- | --- | | macOS | `.dmg` or `.zip` | Apple Silicon (`arm64`) / Intel (`amd64`) | | Windows | Installer `-installer.exe` or portable `.zip` | x64 | | Linux | `.deb`, `.rpm`, or `.AppImage` (download only) | x64 (`amd64`) / ARM64 (`arm64`, aarch64) | Every package ships with a `.minisig` signature, and the release carries `SHA256SUMS`. Once installed, Studio updates itself in place. The same release also carries the 2.x `reasonix` CLI as archives for `darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64`. The Android build ships on that release as `ReasonixMobile-.apk` (`arm64`, Android 8.0 or newer). The kernel and the page run on the phone, and the agent reaches your servers over SSH; pairing with a computer is done by scanning the code it shows. The APK is signed with the Android release key rather than minisign, so it carries a `.sha256` and no `.minisig`. When that key is absent the build is named `ReasonixMobile--unsigned.apk`. Android refuses to install an unsigned package, so those builds stay a workflow artifact for whoever wants to sign one, and the release carries no APK at all. ### Reasonix 1.x (stable) The 1.x CLI installs through npm on any supported platform, or Homebrew on macOS: ```sh npm i -g reasonix # any OS; pulls the prebuilt native binary brew install esengine/reasonix/reasonix # macOS ``` The 1.x desktop app is on the [official download page](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start). Windows installers are code-signed with a Certum code-signing certificate. ### VS Code extension The extension does not bundle the CLI; it starts your local `reasonix acp` backend and adds native chat, editor context, tool-call approvals, model selection, and workspace sessions. Install the 1.x CLI first. - **VS Code:** [install from Visual Studio Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=SivanLiu.reasonix-agent) - **VSCodium / Eclipse Theia:** [install from Open VSX Registry](https://open-vsx.org/extension/SivanLiu/reasonix-agent) - **Extension ID:** `SivanLiu.reasonix-agent` · [source and usage guide](https://github.com/SivanCola/reasonix-vscode) ### Build from source Clone the repository; `studio` builds 2.x and `main-v2` builds 1.x: ```sh git clone https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix.git cd DeepSeek-Reasonix git switch studio ``` #### CLI The CLI build requires **Go 1.25+**. The module pins a `toolchain` directive; keep `GOTOOLCHAIN=auto` so Go downloads the pinned toolchain, or install it. ```sh make build # -> bin/reasonix(.exe) make cross # -> dist/ (darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64) ``` #### Studio Studio additionally requires **Node 24+ and pnpm 10** (`npm install -g pnpm@10`) for the frontend. ```sh make studio ``` See the [Studio build guide](desktop/README.md#prerequisites) for platform webview dependencies and Linux build tags. ## Quick start ### Reasonix Studio Install and launch Studio, then connect a provider and model in the app. No CLI setup is needed. ### CLI / TUI ```sh reasonix setup # configure a provider and model reasonix # start an interactive session reasonix run "implement the TODOs in main.go" ``` In an interactive session, run `/init` when you want Reasonix to create project instructions. For advanced CLI usage and configuration, see the **[CLI reference](./docs/CLI.md)**, **[Guide](./docs/GUIDE.md)**, and **[configuration paths](./docs/CONFIG_PATHS.md)**. ## Documentation - **Getting started:** [Guide](./docs/GUIDE.md) · [CLI reference](./docs/CLI.md) · [Configuration paths](./docs/CONFIG_PATHS.md) · [ACP editor integration](./docs/ACP.md) · [Use from DeepSeek Harness](./docs/DSH.md) - **Features & troubleshooting:** [Subagent profiles](./docs/SUBAGENT_PROFILES.md) · [Context Engine v2](./docs/SESSION_MEMORY_RETRIEVAL.md) · [Capability diagnostics](./docs/CAPABILITY_DIAGNOSTICS.md) · [Recovery and updates](./docs/RECOVERY.md) · [Checkpoints & rewind](./docs/CHECKPOINTS.md) - **Agent presets:** [Session Agent compositions](./docs/AGENT_COMPOSITIONS.md) - **Engineering & migration:** [Spec](./docs/SPEC.md) · [Task contracts & pause policy](./docs/TASK_CONTRACT.md) · [Tool contract](./docs/TOOL_CONTRACT.md) · [Moving from 1.x to 2.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md) · [2.x roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md) - **Extension development:** [Skills](./docs/SKILLS.md) · [Extensions](./docs/EXTENSIONS.md) · [Plugin packages and Manifest v1](./docs/PLUGIN_PACKAGES.md) · [Extension Protocol](./docs/EXTENSION_PROTOCOL.md) · [Go SDK and starter](./sdk/go/README.md) ## Star History
## Acknowledgments A small list of folks whose work has shaped Reasonix the most — the current top 20 contributors by commit count. The full contributor graph is on [GitHub](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/graphs/contributors?all=1). | Contributor | Contributor | Contributor | Contributor | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | [**SivanCola**](https://github.com/SivanCola) | [**KHG420**](https://github.com/KHG420) | [**ttmouse**](https://github.com/ttmouse) | [**chuiwenwei**](https://github.com/chuiwenwei) | | [**lifu963**](https://github.com/lifu963) | [**XTLine**](https://github.com/XTLine) | [**HUQIANTAO**](https://github.com/HUQIANTAO) | [**xxoingr**](https://github.com/xxoingr) | | [**Harbor404**](https://github.com/Harbor404) | [**GTC2080**](https://github.com/GTC2080) | [**mchenziyi**](https://github.com/mchenziyi) | [**Li-Charles-One**](https://github.com/Li-Charles-One) | | [**light-front-theory**](https://github.com/light-front-theory) | [**imcreazy**](https://github.com/imcreazy) | [**eghrhegpe**](https://github.com/eghrhegpe) | [**noreply**](https://github.com/noreply) | | [**par73e**](https://github.com/par73e) | [**Bernardxu123**](https://github.com/Bernardxu123) | [**lancy69**](https://github.com/lancy69) | [**Guan0923**](https://github.com/Guan0923) | Special thanks to [**Bernardxu123**](https://github.com/Bernardxu123) for designing the project logo and intro video.

latestRelease.name: Reasonix Studio v2.56.1
latestRelease.body:
本版是修复版：收紧只读命令判定中 `python -v` 的漏洞，限制模型同时打开的网页数量，并修复手机窄屏布局、定时运行按钮空白、待发送区误显示按钮、中文路径导致会话读不出等问题。

## 变更

- 工作区在网络盘（如 SMB 映射盘）上时，运行无法判断写入范围的命令前的目录遍历改为并发读取，大目录树上等待大幅缩短。关联 #14813。
- 启动环境摘要优先复用当前数据目录的可信快照，避免其他目录的探测结果改变系统提示、降低首次请求的缓存命中率。修复 #14676 by @SivanCola。

## 修复

- 安全：只读命令判定现在只把 `node` 和 `python` 单独的版本探针（如 `python3 -V`）当作只读；`python3 -v 脚本` 这类会运行代码的调用需要批准。关联 #14886。
- 模型同时打开的网页上限为 12 个，超过时会提示它先关闭用完的页面，避免一次搜索开出几十个页面占用数 GB 内存；你自己打开的页面不受限。修复 #14844 fixed in #14866。
- 手机窄屏：侧栏菜单按钮不再紧贴标志；设置页「关闭」与放大按钮并排，设置标签按内容宽度排列。修复 #14865 fixed in #14873、#14867 fixed in #14873、#14868 fixed in #14873。
- 「自动化 → 定时运行」的「预览」和「确认创建」按钮不再显示为空白。修复 #14870 fixed in #14871。
- 待发送区里已被当前轮接收的插话只显示「立即发送」与「取回」，不再出现点了就报"当前状态不允许此操作"的「改」和移动按钮。修复 #14875 fixed in #14877。
- 会话的分支信息含中文路径时，不再因编码误判丢掉反斜杠、导致整个会话读不出来。关联 #14841 by @ShryukGrandhi。
- 内置浏览器拾取元素时，属性名按属性值同样的上限裁剪。关联 #14580、#14849 by @jf200s。
- `/migrate` 读不到旧会话目录时会报出目录和原因，不再说没有需要迁移的会话。关联 #14823 by @chuiwenwei。
- `doctor repair` 读不到配置时报告 unreadable 并以非零退出，`--apply` 不再改写它；`doctor runtime` 没有可询问的 runtime 时显示 unknown。关联 #14824 by @chuiwenwei、#14825 by @chuiwenwei。
- 完成报告、步骤提示和能力诊断里截断的中文等多字节文字不再出现半个字符。关联 #14842 by @kevin9327、#14843 by @kevin9327、#14851 by @kevin9327。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@SivanCola、@ShryukGrandhi、@jf200s、@chuiwenwei、@kevin9327

---

<!-- lang:en -->

## Changed

- With the workspace on a network drive such as an SMB share, the walk before an unclassified command reads concurrently, much faster on big trees. Refs #14813.
- Startup summaries prefer the current data home's trusted snapshot, so another directory's probe no longer changes the system prompt and cold-starts the cache. Fixes #14676 by @SivanCola.

## Fixed

- Security: the read-only check treats only a bare `node` or `python` version probe (such as `python3 -V`) as a read; `python3 -v script` and other calls that run code need approval. Refs #14886.
- The model can have at most 12 pages open; past that it is asked to close finished ones, so one search no longer opens dozens. Your own pages are not limited. Fixes #14844 fixed in #14866.
- On a phone, the sidebar menu button no longer touches the logo, Settings puts Close beside expand, and its tabs fit their content. Fixes #14865 fixed in #14873, #14867 fixed in #14873, #14868 fixed in #14873.
- The "Preview" and "Confirm" buttons of Automation → Scheduled runs no longer show blank. Fixes #14870 fixed in #14871.
- Guidance the running turn already accepted shows only send-now and withdraw in the pending panel, not the edit and move buttons that always failed. Fixes #14875 fixed in #14877.
- A branch record holding a CJK path no longer loses a backslash to a wrong charset guess, which made the whole session unreadable. Refs #14841 by @ShryukGrandhi.
- When the built-in browser picks an element, attribute names are clipped to the same limit as values. Refs #14580, #14849 by @jf200s.
- `/migrate` names the directory and the cause when it cannot read the legacy sessions, instead of saying there was nothing to migrate. Refs #14823 by @chuiwenwei.
- `doctor repair` reports an unreadable config and exits non-zero, `--apply` leaves it alone; `doctor runtime` says unknown with no runtime to ask. Refs #14824 by @chuiwenwei, #14825 by @chuiwenwei.
- Multi-byte text cut in completion reports, step hints and capability diagnostics no longer ends in half a character. Refs #14842 by @kevin9327, #14843 by @kevin9327, #14851 by @kevin9327.

## Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @SivanCola, @ShryukGrandhi, @jf200s, @chuiwenwei, @kevin9327

## What's Changed
* fix(ci): set up pnpm before the Node cache that needs it in the Android workflow by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14811
* fix(ci): run the Android scripts through bash and build the kernel at the tag's version by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14812
* fix(ci): the Android page check writes its token file owner-only by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14814
* perf(agent): read the criteria walk's directories and files concurrently by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14813
* ci(android): let the workflow build a branch as a trial run that publishes nothing by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14817
* fix(android): verify the two POMs the Gradle classpath needs on CI, and store the file with LF by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14819
* fix(android): verify the Linux aapt2 jar the CI build resolves by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14820
* fix(boot): preserve environment snapshot precedence / 保持环境探测快照前缀稳定 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14676
* fix(android): verify the 24 artifacts the release lint task resolves on CI by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14821
* fix(doctor): a runtime nobody can ask is not clean by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14825
* fix(sessionstore): decode the branch-meta sidecar as UTF-8 before transcoding by @ShryukGrandhi in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14841
* fix(evidence): cut a cited command in a rejection message on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14842
* fix(complete_step): cut listed commands in the citation hint on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14843
* fix(doctor): an unreadable config is not a missing one by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14824
* feat(studio): pick an element in the built-in browser by @jf200s in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14795
* fix(studio): clip attribute keys like their values by @jf200s in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14849
* ci(windows): give the full push suite room for a slow boot package by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14848
* fix(migrate): an unreadable source is not an empty one by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14823
* test(migration): skip the unreadable-source cases where the platform cannot build one by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14850
* fix(capdiag): cap sanitized diagnostic text on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14851
* fix(browser): bound the pages the agent can have open at once by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14866
* fix(studio): a primary button in settings keeps its fill with its foreground by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14871
* fix(studio): phone-width spacing for the sidebar logo and the Settings header by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14873
* fix(queue): draw edit and move only on lines the kernel can still change by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14877
* fix(shellsafe): read-only only for a bare node or python version probe by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14886
* docs(release): studio 2.56.1 notes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14887


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.56.0...studio-v2.56.1

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** Debian 系从 `.deb` 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 `.rpm` 安装（`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 `.AppImage`（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 `--appimage-extract-and-run` 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。
